abstract: We present a rare case of an apocrine adenocarcinoma arising in a mature cystic teratoma of the ovary. The patient, a 41-year-old woman, was admitted to the hospital with low back pain and hypermenorrhea. A unilocular cystic tumor, measuring 5.5 x 5.0 cm in diameter, was found in her right ovary, and was removed. The tumor contained a mural nodule, measuring 8 x 7 mm in diameter. Microscopically, the unilocular cystic tumor was a teratoma consisting of mature cutaneous tissue with numerous hairs. The mural nodule was composed mostly of cords of epithelial cells with an infiltrative fashion and anastomosing tubular structures, which were lined partly by cells with eosinophilic cytoplasm and decapitation secretion. The cytoplasm contained iron granules as well as granules that were stained with periodic acid-Schiff, with and without diastase digestion.
abstract_ja: 41歳女性が低腰痛と月経過多で入院した。右卵巣に単房性嚢胞性腫瘍(5.5×5.0cm)が認められ、摘出された。腫瘍内には直径8×7mmの壁在結節が存在していた。顕微鏡的に、単房性嚢胞性腫瘍は多数の毛髪を伴う成熟した皮膚組織からなる奇形腫であった。壁在結節は、浸潤性の増殖を示す上皮細胞索と吻合する管状構造から主になっていた。これらの管状構造の一部は、好酸性の細胞質と断頭分泌を示す細胞に覆われていた。細胞質には鉄顆粒と、ジアスターゼ消化の有無にかかわらずPAS染色陽性の顆粒が含まれていた。
